0aa0f46a-e923-4528-a411-500cbda6e77b.name: n_samples
0aa0f46a-e923-4528-a411-500cbda6e77b.description:
If int, it is the total number of points equally divided among
clusters.
If array-like, each element of the sequence indicates
the number of samples per cluster.

.. versionchanged:: v0.20
    one can now pass an array-like to the ``n_samples`` parameter

159e0416-3873-469b-915b-1f186579c380.name: n_features
159e0416-3873-469b-915b-1f186579c380.description: The number of features for each sample.

39ed839d-f632-4373-9d72-6ce95b5bc265.name: random_state
39ed839d-f632-4373-9d72-6ce95b5bc265.description:
Determines random number generation for dataset creation. Pass an int
for reproducible output across multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.

3e15081a-9ca5-48bf-9159-9a95331a7894.name: center_box
3e15081a-9ca5-48bf-9159-9a95331a7894.description:
The bounding box for each cluster center when centers are
generated at random.

669986a2-03d6-4de4-af41-f9395cf0ef57.name: cluster_std
669986a2-03d6-4de4-af41-f9395cf0ef57.description: The standard deviation of the clusters.

70f4e095-c286-4379-a5f5-4d02df40e1a5.name: return_centers
70f4e095-c286-4379-a5f5-4d02df40e1a5.description:
If True, then return the centers of each cluster.

.. versionadded:: 0.23

8a10b368-9a0e-4390-b2f7-bd4ff27570d3.name: centers
8a10b368-9a0e-4390-b2f7-bd4ff27570d3.description:
The number of centers to generate, or the fixed center locations.
If n_samples is an int and centers is None, 3 centers are generated.
If n_samples is array-like, centers must be
either None or an array of length equal to the length of n_samples.
